  <bpmn:process id="PROCESS" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LANES">
      <bpmn:lane id="L_SYS" name="Inventory system">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>monitor</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>signal</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>updateDates</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>record</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>updateLevels</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>end</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="L_PROC" name="Procurement team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>order</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="L_WH" name="Warehouse staff">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>receive</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>inspect</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>shelve</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="start" name="Monitoring begins" />
    <bpmn:task id="monitor" name="Monitor inventory levels" />
    <bpmn:task id="signal" name="Signal the need to reorder" />
    <bpmn:task id="order" name="Place an order with suppliers" />
    <bpmn:task id="updateDates" name="Update the inventory system with expected delivery dates" />
    <bpmn:task id="receive" name="Receive the stock" />
    <bpmn:task id="inspect" name="Inspect the stock for quality" />
    <bpmn:task id="record" name="Record the stock in the system" />
    <bpmn:task id="shelve" name="Place the stock on shelves or in storage" />
    <bpmn:task id="updateLevels" name="Update the inventory levels" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="end" name="Restock complete" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="start" targetRef="monitor" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f2" sourceRef="monitor" targetRef="signal" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f3" sourceRef="signal" targetRef="order" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f4" sourceRef="order" targetRef="updateDates" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f5" sourceRef="updateDates" targetRef="receive" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f6" sourceRef="receive" targetRef="inspect" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f7" sourceRef="inspect" targetRef="record" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f8" sourceRef="record" targetRef="shelve" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f9" sourceRef="shelve" targetRef="updateLevels" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f10" sourceRef="updateLevels" targetRef="end" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
